description: Development routing policy separating environmental performance, SME financial health and readiness/context evidence. Activity modules route assessment topics; they are not DEMATEL driver domains and do not themselves score applicants.

fact_questions.manufactures_or_processes: Do you manufacture or process physical products?
fact_questions.burns_fuel_on_site: Do your operations burn fuel on site, for example in a generator or boiler?
fact_questions.operates_vehicle_fleet: Does the company operate a vehicle fleet?
fact_questions.operates_facility: Does the company operate an office, workshop, plant or other facility?
fact_questions.uses_cloud_services: Does the business use cloud or data-centre services?
fact_questions.handles_materials_or_waste: Are physical materials or waste a meaningful part of your operations?
fact_questions.provides_clean_energy: Do you deliver clean-energy generation, equipment or services?
fact_questions.provides_circular_services: Do you repair, reuse, recycle or recover products or materials?
fact_questions.works_on_buildings: Do you construct, retrofit or operate buildings as part of your service?
fact_questions.works_in_agriculture_food_land: Do you farm, process food or manage land?
fact_questions.provides_digital_services: Does the company provide software or professional services?
fact_questions.offers_environmental_solution: Is reducing environmental impact an intended function of your product or service?
fact_questions.operates_retail_or_hospitality: Do you operate retail, restaurant or hospitality premises?
fact_questions.plans_operational_transition: Does your application include an operational environmental improvement project?

criteria.title: Nature and basis of green contribution
criteria.question: What environmental benefit does your activity provide, and what example or record can you share?
criteria.assessment_note: Collect the contribution and evidence basis. A green label alone is not a performance score. No-emissions data is not no-green-contribution.

criteria.title: Financial position and funding purpose
criteria.question: Describe your current business stage, financial position and intended use of any funding.
criteria.assessment_note: Pre-revenue is a business stage, not an automatic adverse outcome. Revenue is not itself a universally beneficial score.

criteria.title: Direct operational emissions assessment route
criteria.question: What can you share about fuel use or process emissions: a calculation, fuel records, an approximate range, or an explanation of what is not measured?
criteria.assessment_note: Manufacturing activates investigation; it does not prove direct emissions exist. A reviewed override can narrow the route. Qualitative management evidence cannot become tonnes of emissions.

criteria.title: Purchased energy and cloud-service management
criteria.question: How do you obtain and manage electricity or cloud services? Share bills, supplier details, monitoring practices or an approximate usage range if available.
criteria.assessment_note: Management practices and physical consumption become separate observations later. No direct combustion does not remove purchased-energy impacts.

criteria.title: Material use, waste and recovery
criteria.question: Describe material inputs, waste or recovery in your operations. What records, quantities or approximate ranges are available?
criteria.assessment_note: Recovery and recycling are not automatically equivalent. Denominators, material types and reporting periods must be established before quantitative comparison.

criteria.title: Environmental effect delivered to customers
criteria.question: What changes for customers using your solution? Share a deployment, pilot, test, customer record or clearly labelled estimate.
criteria.assessment_note: Separate demonstrated impact from potential, and establish a baseline. Installed capacity is not automatically generated energy or avoided emissions.

criteria.title: Feasibility of an operational transition
criteria.question: What change will you implement, who will deliver it, and what budget, quotation, schedule or baseline supports it?
criteria.assessment_note: This records project-execution readiness and evidence. Targets inform feasibility; they cannot be counted as achieved environmental performance or converted automatically from DEMATEL prominence.
